clue.text: Hold horse's head with lad having fallen badly

indicators.note: the head of the horse is its opening letter

parts.note: the head of a horse is the opening letter of the word horse

indicators.note: letters of fallen arranged badly, i.e. jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
a lad is a son

explanation.surface: A wrestling or riding scene: someone grabs a horse's head as a boy takes a nasty tumble.
explanation.walkthrough: The SON piece comes last in the answer even though 'lad' appears before 'fallen badly' in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A half nelson is a wrestling grip, so it is a kind of hold applied to an opponent's arm and neck.

clue.text: Hold firm attitude about accepting somebody covering for something

clue.text: Mock article's concluding section
